# verify/lang/ast

`verify/lang/ast` — vector-lang, the expression language a program is
written in, as Nish classes: an expression tree, the clauses and functions
built from it, and the spec plan whose axioms the clauses cite. The shapes
mirror `schemas/program.json` and `schemas/spec-plan.json`.

Generated from [src/verify/lang/ast.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/verify/lang/ast.ts).

### EXPR_NUM

A decimal literal, kept as its text so the solver sees the exact rational.

```ts
const EXPR_NUM: i32 = 1
```

<a id="expr_bool"></a>

### EXPR_BOOL

`true` or `false`.

```ts
const EXPR_BOOL: i32 = 2
```

<a id="expr_var"></a>

### EXPR_VAR

A parameter, or `result` in an ensures clause.

```ts
const EXPR_VAR: i32 = 3
```

<a id="expr_unop"></a>

### EXPR_UNOP

`not`, `neg`, `abs`, `floor` or `ceil` over one argument.

```ts
const EXPR_UNOP: i32 = 4
```

<a id="expr_binop"></a>

### EXPR_BINOP

An arithmetic, comparison or logical operator over two arguments.

```ts
const EXPR_BINOP: i32 = 5
```

<a id="expr_ite"></a>

### EXPR_ITE

`cond ? then : else`.

```ts
const EXPR_ITE: i32 = 6
```

<a id="expr_call"></a>

### EXPR_CALL

A call to a function of a strictly lower layer.

```ts
const EXPR_CALL: i32 = 7
```

### LangExpr

One vector-lang expression. Which fields mean something depends on `kind`.

```ts
class LangExpr
```

#### new LangExpr

Makes an expression.

```ts
new LangExpr(
  kind: i32,
  op: string,
  value: string,
  name: string,
  args: LangExpr[],
): LangExpr
```

<scalar-field name="kind" type="i32" required>

one of the `EXPR_*` kinds

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="op" type="string" required>

the operator, or ""

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="value" type="string" required>

the literal text, or ""

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="name" type="string" required>

the variable or callee, or ""

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="args" type="LangExpr[]" required>

the sub-expressions

</scalar-field>

#### LangExpr.args

unop `[arg]`, binop `[left, right]`, ite `[cond, then, else]`, call arguments.

```ts
args: LangExpr[]
```

#### LangExpr.kind

One of the `EXPR_*` kinds.

```ts
kind: i32
```

#### LangExpr.name

A var's name, or the function a call names; "" otherwise.

```ts
name: string
```

#### LangExpr.numTy

The type the checker gave a num literal, `Real` or `Int`; "" before checking.

```ts
numTy: string
```

#### LangExpr.op

The operator of a unop or binop; "" otherwise.

```ts
op: string
```

#### LangExpr.ty

The type the checker gave this expression, `Real`, `Int` or `Bool`; "" before checking.

```ts
ty: string
```

#### LangExpr.value

A num's decimal text, or a bool's `true`/`false`; "" otherwise.

```ts
value: string
```
